flora: Gnetales leaf (broad, leathery, weathered edges, deep veins)
Reproductive cone (small, flower-like spike, slightly waxy texture)
Young shrublet (sturdy, low-profile, emerging from cracked silt)
Stem segment (jointed, woody, with fine bark texture)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the thick, 'unbreakable' feel of arid-adapted leaves; tactile wood grain; clear focus on botanical identification.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tile composition: Top-Left: a single broad, leathery leaf; Top-Right: a close-up of the flower-like reproductive spike; Bottom-Left: a young seedling emerging from a mud crack; Bottom-Right: a detailed section of the woody, jointed stem.
visual_logic.ground: Fine-grained red siltstone with a dry, matte finish, providing a warm backdrop for the green plant elements.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, bright, diffused light to showcase the unique morphology of the Gnetales without heavy shadows.
